Welcome to the LibreTexts Commons - Your portal to the LibreVerse!

The LibreText Commons hosts curated Open Educational Resources from all 16 libraries in the LibreVerse in one convenient location. We believe everyone should have access to knowledge and we are happy to share our OER corpus to everyone completely free.
